results.name: 🏟️ Big Spirited State School
results.blurb: Huge, proud, buzzing with traditions.
results.schools: 1. Michigan — the strongest academics of this group · 2. UT–Austin — huge school, huge city to match · 3. Penn State — legendary traditions, massive alumni reach · 4. Ohio State — the loudest gameday of them all

results.name: 💼 Business Powerhouse
results.blurb: A famous, competitive program that opens serious doors.
results.schools: 1. UPenn (Wharton) — most selective, deepest finance recruiting · 2. NYU (Stern) — same doors, Manhattan on top · 3. Michigan (Ross) — best public option in this group · 4. UVA (McIntire) — smaller and just as respected · 5. UNC (Kenan-Flagler) — most affordable in-state option

results.name: 🚀 Entrepreneurial / Startup Campus
results.blurb: Built for founders and makers.
results.schools: 1. Stanford — closest thing to the center of startup culture · 2. MIT — the most technical founders come out of here · 3. Babson — built entirely around entrepreneurship · 4. USC (Marshall) — strong founder culture with an LA network

results.name: 🌆 City Hustle School
results.blurb: In the middle of a real city, where class and career blur.
results.schools: 1. NYU — the biggest city, the biggest name · 2. Boston University — a real city at a smaller scale · 3. Northeastern — built around co-ops in the middle of Boston · 4. Fordham — same city as NYU, easier admissions bar

results.name: 🤖 Tech-Meets-Business
results.blurb: Where business brains and builders collide.
results.schools: 1. Carnegie Mellon — the strongest tech-meets-business reputation · 2. UC Berkeley (Haas) — Silicon Valley on your doorstep · 3. Georgia Tech — best value for the tech strength · 4. Cornell — an Ivy with real engineering chops

results.name: 🌳 Close-Knit Community
results.blurb: Smaller, warmer, personal — professors know your name.
results.schools: 1. Villanova — small, respected, personal · 2. Wake Forest — same closeness, stronger national name · 3. Bentley — business-only, everyone knows everyone · 4. Bryant — smallest of the group, most personal attention

results.name: 🌍 Global / Study-Abroad Campus
results.blurb: Languages, cultures, and a semester (or four) abroad.
results.schools: 1. Georgetown — the strongest international-affairs name · 2. Middlebury — famous for languages and study abroad · 3. American University — DC access plus a global focus · 4. Boston University — study abroad at a bigger scale

results.name: 🎭 Creative / Arts-Meets-Business
results.blurb: Where design, media, and entertainment meet the business side.
results.schools: 1. USC — film, media, and business all in one place · 2. NYU (Tisch + Stern) — same idea, in the middle of NYC · 3. The New School (Parsons) — design-first, business-adjacent · 4. Emerson — smaller, media-focused, tight-knit
